description: Traffic Count is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Perth. The City of Perth traffic count provides information about the number of vehicles, speed of travel and peak travel numbers on particular roads within the Perth LGA (Local Government Area). Coverage: City of Perth. The portal files it under the publisher City of Perth. Its tags are 3857, PV - Public View, Roads ODP, TRAFFIC COUNT. It offers 1 resource(s) in OTHER. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
